name: Movyz Source Worker
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -n "$SUPABASE_URL" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_ANON_KEY" ] && [ -n "$SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY" ]; then nohup npm run bot >/tmp/movyz-source-bot.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/movyz-source-bot.pid; else echo "Movyz bot not started: add the three Codespaces secrets first."; fi'
